source.rightsEvidence: The pinned repository includes an MIT license for its source. Meridian CREDITS.txt identifies its only included photograph as CC0 1.0 or Public Domain Mark; other photographic placeholders are CSS gradients. Both records and the Bootstrap MIT notice are retained in this dossier.

capture.method: Rendered from the pinned local repository with Playwright 1.63.0 and Chromium. No gallery screenshot or screenshot download was used.
capture.captureNotes: The credited CC0 hero photograph was loaded locally; CSS-generated gradient blocks were left intact. A closed off-canvas navigation dialog was hidden only in the capture page. No visible page content was modified. The measured document had no horizontal overflow at either viewport. The city-skyline photograph is not evidence of the demo clinic's premises and must not imply that a client clinic is there.

provenance.attribution: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates, MIT source license. Include the MIT copyright and permission notice with copies or substantial portions. The sole included photograph is CC0 or public domain as itemized in rights/CREDITS.txt.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A practical healthcare site begins with a slim emergency/contact utility strip and a compact clinic wordmark navigation with a direct appointment action. The first major section is a split composition: a large promise, short lede, two clear actions, and concise trust facts are balanced by an embedded appointment-request panel. Below, an icon-led service directory supports scanning, a provider/organization chapter is available for verified profiles, and a patient-information chapter pairs native expandable questions with hours and contact details. The overall language is bright and calm, with pale clinical surfaces and a restrained teal accent. Every source clinic name, location, phone, emergency instruction, provider, specialty, credential, insurer, price, wait time, outcome, and medical statement is fictional demo material and cannot be reused.

heroGeometry.mode: utility strip then a two-column clinical opening with an embedded appointment panel
heroGeometry.alignment: copy and service signals in the broad column, booking form in a narrower sidecar
heroGeometry.viewport: show the primary appointment path and a short factual promise immediately; no made-up statistics are needed to fill the space

navigationGeometry.mode: edge-to-edge utility strip above a compact brand and section navigation
navigationGeometry.placement: utility information at the top edge, navigation directly below it
navigationGeometry.mobile: small accessible drawer; preserve the urgent contact route only when supplied and regionally verified

typography.display: high-legibility contemporary sans with a strong but restrained clinical headline
typography.body: neutral sans with generous line-height for healthcare information
typography.scale: large concise hero title, clear service names, compact utility labels, readable form labels and patient information

palette.ink: deep blue-green or charcoal for main text with muted slate secondary text
palette.contrastIntent: high text contrast and legible form states; color must never be the sole urgency or validation cue

imageTreatment.mode: one understated hero photo with low-contrast service surfaces and CSS or client-owned portrait areas
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero crop; small people or place images only when actual client assets exist
imageTreatment.focalPoint: do not treat the reference skyline or placeholder gradients as a clinic, clinician, or treatment image

servicePresentation.pattern: scannable icon-led directory with a real service name, brief factual scope, and descriptive link
servicePresentation.interaction: standard links and focus-visible states; no hidden details required to understand the service
servicePresentation.adaptation: use only services in the verified business profile; remove provider, payment, insurance, diagnostic, or treatment-specific rows when unsupported

ctaPlacement.primary: appointment request in the hero booking panel and the navigation action
ctaPlacement.early: a useful next step is visible in the opening viewport, but should not promise an appointment slot or medical outcome

motion.primitive: native form validation, calendar/service selection only when supported by a real handler, and HTML details/summary FAQ disclosure
motion.reducedMotion: all information remains visible and controls work without transitions; no auto-opening, flashing, or parallax

mobileRecomposition.strategy: utility strip, compact navigation, then stacked promise and appointment form
rules: stack hero copy and form in a deliberate order with the action near the promise
do not put an overlong form in a narrow sticky overlay
flow service links into a single-column or two-column list based on text length
keep FAQ answers and hours readable with large tap targets
ensure emergency/contact details do not overflow or become ambiguous on small screens

prohibitedPatterns: copying Meridian or its sample clinic, city, address, phone, emergency advice, doctors, credentials, insurers, prices, hours, wait times, or outcome statistics
making clinical, diagnostic, safety, efficacy, urgent-care, or treatment claims without approved evidence and appropriate review
presenting the city skyline as the client's practice location or using CSS gradient blocks as fake clinician portraits
claiming a booking form confirms, schedules, or transmits an appointment when no working integration exists
showing sensitive patient data or collecting unnecessary health details in a marketing form
using color alone for errors, emergency status, consent, or booking selection

requiredSignatureElements.description: compact contact or status strip containing only verified information
an accessible inquiry panel aligned with the hero promise
an icon-led, scannable list of verified services
patient FAQs and practical contact/hours information presented together

acceptanceChecks: primary appointment action is visible in the opening viewport and its behavior is accurately described
no invented medical claims, results, credentials, provider identities, emergency routing, or clinical availability appears
services, hours, location, emergency instructions, insurers, and payment details bind only to verified facts
the booking form collects only needed contact/request information and has keyboard and screen-reader labels
desktop and mobile preserve the utility-to-booking-to-services-to-patient-information rhythm without overflow

review.scope: Pinned repository render, per-template CC0 photograph audit, paired viewport captures, and transferable clinical-utility composition only. No demo healthcare claims or medical content are approved for reuse.
